opening.argument: The speaker sells a share as the entry point to a payment opportunity, telling viewers they can be paid every day through Bitcoin mining. She then ties additional earnings to recruiting: participants can earn more by sharing the opportunity, receive matching bonuses when others make money, and collect ongoing commissions from people they introduce who mine. The scale of the claims is substantial, including the stated possibility of $10,000 per day from helping 1,000 people earn specified amounts. Saying participation is optional and outcomes are not promised does not erase the central pitch: buying in and bringing others into the network are presented as routes to daily payments and further income.

citations.quote: You simply buy your share and you are done and then sharing the opportunity with other people so you could get paid more
you too can get paid every single day
for the people that you introduce that are mining every single day, for a very long time, you have an ongoing commission coming
I'm not promising anything you'll find out but it did happen for me
if you decide not to do it, it's ok
